insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they dig deeper than most
insights.text: In 3 G3+ games, 14/15 picks (93%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 15 champs in G1s, 12 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Ryze? They go Orianna
insights.text: Ryze is a G1 favorite (1/3 G1s, played by Ablazeolive). In the 5 later games where it was burned or banned, Ablazeolive went to Orianna (3/5) and Ahri (1/5).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Locke is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Locke in 7/9 games (78%): 0 picks (0-0) and 7 bans.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Cassiopeia against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Cassiopeia against them in 7/9 games (78%).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: They open bans on Vi
insights.text: Vi is their first ban in 4/9 games (44%). Expect it gone before your first pick.
